council_review.testing_qa: Direct, dtype, device, layout, mask, runtime-shape, training, gradient, stress, affected-suite, long-run, memory, profile, final, held-out, organizer-default, source-derived, artifact, notebook, workflow, graph, and repository-suite evidence cover the accepted path.
